verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine that serves models which accept natural-language prompts. The pack shows the engine itself is operated through conventional CLI subcommands, flags, Docker images and APIs (vllm-docs-27, vllm-docs-26). Nothing shows a natural-language command interface for running, configuring or managing vLLM. Tool calling and the OpenAI-compatible API are capabilities of the served models, not ways to operate the product, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
